title: Story premise ENT092: The Laundry Label Mystery
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (everyday microdramas). Hook: Every sock has a label. None of them help. Takeaway/theme: Use the features that actually answer the immediate question.
description: A figure wants to pair socks from a basket, but every sock carries a confusing abstract tag. Instead of deciphering the tags, they lay the socks heel-to-heel and compare shape and length, making pairs; the final unmatched sock becomes a puppet who proudly introduces the basket.
